message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_verify.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":109,"var":"Data/Size","code":"write (fd, Data, Size)","note":"The fuzzer input is copied byte-for-byte into the temporary file that GnuPG will verify."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_verify.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":135,"var":"filename","code":"verify_signatures(ctrlGlobal, 1, &filename)","note":"The crafted file is handed to the signature verifier as attacker-controlled input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"g10/verify.c","function":"verify_signatures","line":111,"var":"fp","code":"rc = proc_signature_packets (ctrl, NULL, fp, sl, sigfile );","note":"Verification opens the file and begins packet processing over the malicious stream."},
  {"step":4,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_signature_packets","line":1413,"var":"a","code":"rc = do_proc_packets (c, a)","note":"The signature-specific packet-processing loop consumes the stream."},
  {"step":5,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1515,"var":"pkt","code":"while ((rc=parse_packet (&parsectx, pkt)) != -1)","note":"Packets are decoded sequentially from the attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":6,"file":"g10/parse-packet.c","function":"parse_plaintext","line":3206,"var":"pt","code":"pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext = xmalloc (sizeof *pkt->pkt.plaintext + namelen - 1);","note":"A plaintext packet object is allocated from the parsed literal-data record and stored in the packet wrapper."},
  {"step":7,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":827,"var":"pt","code":"PKT_plaintext *pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext;","note":"The packet wrapper is converted back to the plaintext pointer for processing."},
  {"step":8,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":949,"var":"pkt","code":"free_packet (pkt, NULL);","note":"The owning packet is freed, releasing the heap object that pt points to."},
  {"step":9,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":956,"var":"pt->namelen","code":"extrahash = xtrymalloc (6 + pt->namelen);","note":"The code immediately reuses the freed plaintext object to compute the extra-hash size, triggering the heap-use-after-free read."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p)
PY
